sources.title: T-Mobile shutters 5 Washington stores, cuts jobs in fall layoffs at Bellevue HQ
sources.description: T-Mobile USA plans to lay off 77 Washington employees between Sept. 21 and Nov. 18, according to a notice filed with the state Employment Security Department.

sources.title: T-Mobile will lay off 5,000 employees, or about 7% of its workforce, in the coming weeks
sources.description: Wireless carrier T-Mobile plans to cut 5,000 jobs, or about 7% of its workforce

sources.title: T-Mobile to lay off 5,000 employees, or about 7% of its workforce, in the coming weeks
sources.description: CEO Michael Sievert said the layoffs would come over the next five weeks and impact T-Mobile workers across the country — particularly those working in corporate and back-office roles, as well as some technology positions.
